      "formal_name": "PiLp.norm_eq_of_L1",
      "informal_name": "L¹ Norm on Product Space: $\\|x\\| = \\sum_i \\|x_i\\|$",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {ι : Type u_2} {β : ι → Type u_4} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : (i : ι) → SeminormedAddCommGroup (β i)] (x : PiLp 1 β),\n  ‖x‖ = ∑ i, ‖x.ofLp i‖",
      "informal_description": "For an element $x$ in the product $L^1$ space $\\Pi L^1$, its norm is equal to the sum of the norms of its components, i.e., $\\|x\\| = \\sum_{i \\in \\iota} \\|x_i\\|$. This follows directly from the definition of the $L^1$ norm on product spaces, where the norm is computed as the sum of the $L^1$ norms of each component function.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Lp.PiLp"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "PiLp.nnnorm_eq_of_L1",
      "informal_name": "L^1 Norm of Product Space Equals Sum of Component Norms",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {ι : Type u_2} {β : ι → Type u_4} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : (i : ι) → SeminormedAddCommGroup (β i)] (x : PiLp 1 β),\n  ‖x‖₊ = ∑ i, ‖x.ofLp i‖₊",
      "informal_description": "For a finite index set $\\iota$ and a family of seminormed additive commutative groups $\\beta(i)$, the $L^1$-norm of an element $x$ in the product $L^p$ space $\\Pi L^1$ satisfies $\\|x\\| = \\sum_{i \\in \\iota} \\|x_i\\|$, where $x_i$ denotes the $i$-th component of $x$.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Lp.PiLp"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "lp.norm_eq_card_dsupport",
      "informal_name": "Norm in $L^0$ Space Equals Support Cardinality",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {α : Type u_3} {E : α → Type u_4} [inst : (i : α) → NormedAddCommGroup (E i)] (f : ↥(lp E 0)), ‖f‖ = ↑⋯.toFinset.card",
      "informal_description": "For any function $f$ in the $L^0$ space (with $p = 0$), the norm $\\|f\\|$ is equal to the cardinality of the finite set of indices where $f(i) \\neq 0$.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Lp.lpSpace"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "lp.norm_sum_single",
      "informal_name": "Norm of Finite Sum of Single-Element Functions in $L^p$",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {α : Type u_3} {E : α → Type u_4} {p : ENNReal} [inst : (i : α) → NormedAddCommGroup (E i)] [inst_1 : DecidableEq α],\n  0 < p.toReal →\n    ∀ (f : (i : α) → E i) (s : Finset α), ‖∑ i ∈ s, lp.single p i (f i)‖ ^ p.toReal = ∑ i ∈ s, ‖f i‖ ^ p.toReal",
      "informal_description": "For any extended non-negative real number $p$ with $0 < p$ and a finite set $s$ of indices, the $L^p$ norm of the sum of single-element functions $\\sum_{i \\in s} \\text{single}_p(i, f_i)$ raised to the power $p$ equals the sum of the $L^p$ norms of the individual elements $f_i$ raised to the power $p$, i.e., $\\left\\|\\sum_{i \\in s} \\text{single}_p(i, f_i)\\right\\|^p = \\sum_{i \\in s} \\|f_i\\|^p$.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Lp.lpSpace"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "PiLp.norm_eq_card",
      "informal_name": "Norm of Pi L⁰ Space Equals Cardinality of Non-Zero Components",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {ι : Type u_2} {β : ι → Type u_4} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : (i : ι) → Norm (β i)] (f : PiLp 0 β),\n  ‖f‖ = ↑⋯.toFinset.card",
      "informal_description": "For an element $ f $ in the $ \\Pi L^0 $ space over a finite index type, the norm $ \\|f\\| $ is equal to the cardinality of the set $ \\{ i \\mid \\|f_i\\| \\neq 0 \\} $, i.e., $ \\|f\\| = \\left| \\{ i \\mid \\|f_i\\| \\neq 0 \\} \\right| $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Lp.PiLp"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "PiLp.norm_toLp_one",
      "informal_name": "Norm of Constant One Function in Product $ L^p $ Space",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {p : ENNReal} {ι : Type u_2} [hp : Fact (1 ≤ p)] [inst : Fintype ι] {β : Type u_5}\n  [inst_1 : SeminormedAddCommGroup β],\n  p ≠ ⊤ → ∀ [inst_2 : One β], ‖WithLp.toLp p 1‖ = ↑↑(Fintype.card ι) ^ (1 / p).toReal * ‖1‖",
      "informal_description": "For a finite index set $\\iota$ and a family of seminormed additive commutative groups $\\beta_i$, if $p \\neq \\infty$, the norm of the constant function $1 : \\iota \\to \\beta$ in the product $L^p$ space is equal to $(\\#\\iota)^{1/p} \\cdot \\|1\\|_{\\beta}$, where $\\#\\iota$ denotes the cardinality of $\\iota$ and $\\|1\\|_{\\beta}$ is the norm of the multiplicative identity in $\\beta$.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Lp.PiLp"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "lp.norm_rpow_eq_tsum",
      "informal_name": "L^p Norm Power Identity: $\\|f\\|^p = \\sum \\|f(i)\\|^p$",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {α : Type u_3} {E : α → Type u_4} {p : ENNReal} [inst : (i : α) → NormedAddCommGroup (E i)],\n  0 < p.toReal → ∀ (f : ↥(lp E p)), ‖f‖ ^ p.toReal = ∑' (i : α), ‖↑f i‖ ^ p.toReal",
      "informal_description": "For a function $ f $ in the $ L^p $ space with $ 1 \\leq p < \\infty $, the $ p $-th power of its $ L^p $ norm equals the sum over all indices $ i $ of the $ p $-th power of the norm of $ f(i) $. Formally, $ \\|f\\|^p = \\sum_{i} \\|f(i)\\|^p $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Lp.lpSpace"
    }
  ]
}

items.informal_description: For an element $x$ in the product $L^1$ space $\Pi L^1$, its norm is equal to the sum of the norms of its components, i.e., $\|x\| = \sum_{i \in \iota} \|x_i\|$. This follows directly from the definition of the $L^1$ norm on product spaces, where the norm is computed as the sum of the $L^1$ norms of each component function.

items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_3} {E : α → Type u_4} {p : ENNReal} [inst : (i : α) → NormedAddCommGroup (E i)] [inst_1 : DecidableEq α],
  0 < p.toReal →
    ∀ (f : (i : α) → E i) (s : Finset α), ‖∑ i ∈ s, lp.single p i (f i)‖ ^ p.toReal = ∑ i ∈ s, ‖f i‖ ^ p.toReal
items.informal_description: For any extended non-negative real number $p$ with $0 < p$ and a finite set $s$ of indices, the $L^p$ norm of the sum of single-element functions $\sum_{i \in s} \text{single}_p(i, f_i)$ raised to the power $p$ equals the sum of the $L^p$ norms of the individual elements $f_i$ raised to the power $p$, i.e., $\left\|\sum_{i \in s} \text{single}_p(i, f_i)\right\|^p = \sum_{i \in s} \|f_i\|^p$.

items.informal_name: Norm of Constant One Function in Product $ L^p $ Space
items.informal_description: For a finite index set $\iota$ and a family of seminormed additive commutative groups $\beta_i$, if $p \neq \infty$, the norm of the constant function $1 : \iota \to \beta$ in the product $L^p$ space is equal to $(\#\iota)^{1/p} \cdot \|1\|_{\beta}$, where $\#\iota$ denotes the cardinality of $\iota$ and $\|1\|_{\beta}$ is the norm of the multiplicative identity in $\beta$.

items.informal_description: For a function $ f $ in the $ L^p $ space with $ 1 \leq p < \infty $, the $ p $-th power of its $ L^p $ norm equals the sum over all indices $ i $ of the $ p $-th power of the norm of $ f(i) $. Formally, $ \|f\|^p = \sum_{i} \|f(i)\|^p $.
